sceneConcept: A slim twenty-four-year-old Chinese trainee metro dispatcher stands alone against a transparent background. His neat side-parted brown hair, brown eyes and clean-shaven student-like face make him look newly hired. He wears a white collared shirt with carefully rolled sleeves, a completely plain grey sweater vest, straight black trousers and black office shoes. Leaning slightly forward, he holds a single dark blank tablet close to his torso while a stylus hovers in his other hand; his nervous concentration suggests every input feels like an exam. Soft even frontal studio light creates no control room, timetable text, trains, holograms or bright rim. Visual refresh: a neat blue sweater vest over a pale shirt with comfortable trousers and a trainee badge.
